title: Survey of Hallucination in Natural Language Generation
read_version: Historical author version arXiv:2202.03629v5, 7 November 2022; publisher PDF inaccessible (403)
covered_axes: Task-relative definitions; intrinsic/extrinsic hallucination; source/world distinction; statistical/model/human metrics; data, modeling, and inference mitigation.
existing_comparability_or_audit: Discusses verifier error propagation, fine-grained evaluation, and metric generalization; not merely a list of tasks.
overlap_with_current: The distinction between source support and world truth and the need for reliable metrics are established background.
defensible_increment: Apply explicit compatibility fields to a fixed contemporary LLM study set and preserve study-specific evidence locators.
claim_boundary: Do not claim a new factuality/faithfulness distinction. Do not attribute the 2024 arXiv additions to the 2023 journal article.
metadata_verification: Crossref DOI deposit checked against arXiv related DOI; use canonical 10-author journal metadata, not the 11-author v5 list.

title: Factuality of Large Language Models: A Survey
fulltext_locators: PDF pp.2–4 §§2–3 and Table2; p.7 §4.4/Figure1; pp.8–9 §§6–7
covered_axes: Factuality evaluation by answer format; training and inference interventions; fact-checking pipelines and correction.
existing_comparability_or_audit: Explicitly identifies heterogeneous benchmarks/metrics, verifier reliability, intermediate-step quality, and retrieval/compute costs as comparison problems.
overlap_with_current: Reference frames, generation-versus-discrimination, claim/retrieval/verification decomposition, and calls for fair comparison already overlap.
defensible_increment: Turn these concerns into a documented, study-level compatibility audit with information, evaluator, resource, and composition fields.
claim_boundary: Do not say this survey lacks comparison or only catalogs methods. Do not present pipeline decomposition as new.
metadata_verification: Official ACL landing page, PDF, BibTeX and DOI agree; already in master bibliography.

title: Siren’s Song in the AI Ocean: A Survey on Hallucination in Large Language Models
covered_axes: Input-, context-, and fact-conflicting errors; evaluation benchmarks and metrics; mitigation across training and inference.
existing_comparability_or_audit: Discusses underinformativeness/over-refusal separately from hallucination and questions the link between discrimination and generation performance.
overlap_with_current: Information retention, evaluator reliability, and detection/generation relationships cannot be claimed as previously unrecognized.
defensible_increment: Provide traceable case comparisons of the reporting conditions needed to infer useful-generation or combined-system gains.
claim_boundary: Credit the existing conceptual analysis. Claim a narrower operational synthesis rather than broader coverage.
metadata_verification: Official ACL BibTeX cross-checked with DOI/Crossref: volume51 issue4 pp1373–1418, December2025. Official title includes decorative mermaid emoji.

title: Do My Eyes Deceive Me? A Survey of Human Evaluations of Hallucinations in NLG
covered_axes: Human evaluation; grounding, verifiability, and granularity definitions; annotation and reporting practices.
existing_comparability_or_audit: Audits 64 human evaluations from 61 papers using ten reporting fields, including definitions, guidelines, interface, annotators, and agreement.
overlap_with_current: A hallucination documentation audit and structured definition axes already exist.
defensible_increment: Use method/evaluation configurations spanning automatic detection and mitigation as the analysis unit, with explicit information, evaluator, resource, and composition conditions.
claim_boundary: Do not claim the first reporting audit or interpret undocumented fields as absent practice. Do not confuse 64 evaluations with 64 distinct papers.
metadata_verification: ACL BibTeX and official PDF matched; author institutional repository corroborates venue/pages/authors. ACL DOI field is empty; no DOI invented.

title: Large language models hallucination: A comprehensive survey
read_version: Author version arXiv:2510.06265v3, 18 March2026; canonical journal metadata August2026
covered_axes: Five detection families, four mitigation families, explainability, benchmarks/metrics, and cross-study performance tables.
existing_comparability_or_audit: Explicitly discusses shared failure modes in hybrids, task-dependent effectiveness, heterogeneous protocols, computation, and generator/judge reuse.
overlap_with_current: Hybrid-method cautions, domain dependence, evaluator separation concerns, and cost comparisons are substantial existing overlap.
defensible_increment: A fixed-set evidence ledger can distinguish reported controls from unresolved reporting and specify what remains needed for a valid combined-system inference.
claim_boundary: Do not characterize prior surveys as lacking quantitative tables or compatibility discussion; avoid universal cost rankings.
